description: This file implements the stub and proxy classes for the IUnknown interface within the WPEFramework, handling remote procedure calls such as AddRef, Release, and QueryInterface, and managing interface registration and socket communication.

classes.name: UnknownStub
classes.description: Stub class handling incoming IPC messages for IUnknown, implementing methods like Handle to process AddRef, Release, and QueryInterface calls.

classes.name: UnknownProxy
classes.description: Proxy class providing client-side access to the IUnknown interface, including socket retrieval.

classes.name: UnknownInstantiation
classes.description: Static class responsible for registering and deregistering the IUnknown interface with the RPC administrator.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes incoming IPC messages based on method index, calling AddRef, Release, or QueryInterface on the implementation.

methods.name: Socket
methods.description: Returns the socket port associated with the proxy, if available.
